name: Summer Pre-Medical Professions Program (SPMPP)
org: University of Florida, Center for Precollegiate Education and Training
what_you_do: A 5 day program at the UF College of Medicine. You follow patient care, do hands on skills sessions and give a team talk about careers in medicine.
who_can_apply: Rising 11th and 12th graders. The page says the program is open to all students. It is non-residential, so students arrange their own housing and food.
pay_detail: $1,200 program cost plus $25 application fee; need based scholarships
duration: 5 days (three sessions in June and July 2026)
deadline_text: For 2026: applications opened Jan 5 and were due Feb 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply on the CPET online portal. Send a transcript and the recommendations or prompts the page lists.
notes: Works with UF medical students and faculty. Meals and housing are not included.
